title: Austin School Bond Interest Payment Debate
summary:
• **School Bond Interest Funding**: Council met to appropriate $1,125 to pay interest due on $45,000 in high school bonds, with an amendment reducing both figures to $120 and $25,000 respectively.

• **Amendment Dispute**: Alderman Shumate proposed significant cuts to the original appropriation amounts, though the council failed to suspend rules for final passage with only a 2-to-1 vote in favor.

• **Attendance Issues**: Multiple aldermen were absent; three were excused while the city marshal was directed to bring in others, indicating enforcement of council attendance requirements.

Called meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas July 18, 1901.
The Mayor and President of the Council being absent, Ald. Nitscke the Council was called
to order by the City Clerk and Chairman Pro Tem Alderman Nitschke was elected Pro
temporary Chairman Roll Called Present Aldermen Strum Home, Low, Mortimer, Nitschke,
Schneider, Shumate and Strunff.
Absent Aldermen Brooker, Davis, Gillis, Maddox, Redd Shelley and Weit Alderman Schneider

Maddox were excused. The Marshal was directed to bring in the other absentees Alderman
Davis entered the Council Chamber and answered to his name.
There being a quorum present. on motion the Call was Suspended The following Call of the
Council was read.
Austin Texas July 18th 1901.
A special meeting of the City Council is hereby called to meet Call for in the Council
Chamber in City Hall at 5:30 o'clock P.M. this day, Special session for the purpose of
considering and passing an ordinance appropriating the sum of $1125.00 to pay the interest
due July 1st 1901. on $45.000.00 of high School bonds of the City of Austin
F. B. Shelley acting Mayor
J. M. Shumate
Theodore Low
H. B. Davis
I H. Montgomery, City Marshal of the City of Austin do hereby certify that the above Call
has been served upon the following named Aldermen, by having it read to them in person.
Viz: J.C. Schneider J.L. Strum J. H. Weit J. B. Nitschke, O. J. B. Mortimer, H. B. Redd R.
A. Gillis, Joseph Strunff, and that Alderman Maddox and Brooker have been served by having
a true copy left at their residences, they being out of the City H. Montgomery
By R. A. Marshal
Ord. #1125-15 The Chairman laid before the Council an Ordinance pay interest appropriating
the sum of $1125.00 to pay interest due High School bonds July 1st 1901. on High School
bonds. The Ordinance was read the second time.- Alderman Shumate moved to Amend the
ordinance by striking out in the caption Amended and body of the ordinance the words &
figures “1125” and inserting in lieu thereof the words “One Hundred and twenty Dollars.”
Also strike out in Section 1 of the ordinance the figures “$45,000.00” and insert in lieu
thereof “$25,000.00”


 --- Page break --- 

535
The amendments were adopted, and a motion made to suspend the rule and place the ordinance
on its third reading and final passage which motion was lost by the following vote, 2/3rds
not voting Yeas Alderman Davis Hume Low, Thortmon Nitschke Schneider Olumale Strunff
Nays none.
On motion the Council adjourned
Geo. O. Johnson
City Clerk
